lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, showing larger, more isolated nodes posterior to the gill slits and higher spatial frequency in the dorsal-ward progression.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and a defined shadow region immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, elongated silhouette attached to the dorsal midline anterior to the first dorsal fin, consistent with a secondary biological organism (remora).
